title.narrative: Supporting the Islamic Republic of Pakistan with medicines (Paracetamol)

description.narrative: Providing 4 million painkiller tablets (Paracetamol) to the Pakistani Ministry of Health to alleviate the suffering of the Pakistani people as a result of floods and torrents.

Providing urgent health assistance by providing paracetamol medicine to help alleviate the suffering of the Pakistani people affected by floods and torrents, according to the request of the Pakistani side.
To fill the great shortage of paracetamol in hospitals and health centers in the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and to help alleviate the suffering of our sick Pakistani brothers.
